name: Collared Crossed-Subcube Cap Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $X=\{a,b,p,q,z\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}W$, set $U=W\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{z\}$ and $V=\varnothing$, and start with the crossed base having $\alpha=1,\beta=0$. Delete the collared cap $\{\{a,b,p,z\}\cup S:S\subseteq W\}$ and attach a new pendant coordinate above the base with lone lower endpoint $R=\{b,p\}$.
canonical_form: Exchanging the two crossed wings gives the symmetric collared cap based on $\{a,b,q,z\}$.
recognition: A construction certificate lists the deleted crossed wings and decoration, verifies the exact rooted-union hole sets at the complementary endpoints, and checks that their contraction-repair sets cover every base coordinate.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. No pc-minimality or completeness claim is made because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
